claim: Short or partial replays miss rare paths: replay every recording to its end before treating graphics as static.

evidence.text: The first recording showed no writer in the graphics; a later one showed the score frame rewritten; a chase bot found the second one (ghost score) only after six recordings had passed. Treat 'static graphics' as provisional until every recording has passed.
evidence.quote: a chase bot found the second one (ghost score) only after six recordings had passed. Treat "static graphics" as provisional until every recording has passed.

evidence.text: Quick runs: 2000 frames missed two rare cases that 20000 found (XOR effect under a figure, column-31 wrap): run 20000 before stage 3 when the verifier is fast.
